decision.message: Simultaneous measurement of both pressure (BMP280) and humidity (SHT31) on a single board with the ESP32 controller is unsupported by the engineered board families. Each family supports only one sensor type and measurement; combining BMP280 and SHT31 on one board is not supported.

clauses.text: Create one board that measures both pressure and humidity using a BMP280 plus an SHT31, with the shared ESP32 controller.
